source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE item 2: super-SILAC method optimisation comparing IsD, IsG, FASP, FASP+3xSDB-RPS/MM and FASP+6xSCX, in replicates (66 raw files). MaxQuant SS-Proteome summary.txt: Multiplicity 2, Labels0 '' (light), Labels1 'Arg6;Lys8' (heavy) for every file; experiments F_SILAC_Ddig_n, F_SILAC_Sdig_n, F_SILAC_SCX_Sdig_n, F_SILAC_MM_Sdig_n, IsD-U_SILAC_{Ddig,Sdig,SCX_Sdig,MM_Sdig}_n, IsD-G_SILAC_{Ddig,SCX_Ddig,MM_Ddig}_n map one-to-one to SDRF source names/factor values. Per-run C-terminal residue statistics recomputed independently from deposited MaxQuant evidence.txt (unique non-decoy, non-contaminant sequences per raw file): Lys-C eluates (*_ddig_Lys*, DD_L_*) 92-97% K-terminal, 1.5-5% R-terminal, 30-56% internal uncleaved R; trypsin eluates (*_ddig_Trp, DD_T_*) 60-71% R-terminal with <1-8% internal K; single digests 40-51% R-terminal with low internal R; IsD-U double vs single digests show K-terminal share 59.5-60.7% vs 49.4-50.8% and internal K 13-15% vs 31-33%, consistent with added Lys-C; IsD-G runs are named Ddig/DD by the authors' MaxQuant experiments (IsD_G_LFQ_DD_*, IsD-G_SILAC_*_Ddig_*). SDRF: FASP Lys eluates Lys-C; FASP Trp eluates and all Sdig workflows (incl. FASP/IsD-U SCX and MM) Trypsin; IsD-U Ddig and all IsD-G (SS-*, SS_*_SCX_*, SS_*_MM_*) Lys-C + Trypsin. All consistent.

file_mapping.evidence: Fresh PRIDE /files (168 entries, every projectAccessions == PXD003822): 163 RAW + 5 SEARCH zips. design_consistency.evidence: 11 workflows x 2 replicates = 22 MaxQuant experiments; heavy spike-in technical replicate 1-22 = one spike-in aliquot per experiment. Fraction identifiers reproduce MaxQuant fraction order (SCX x1-x5,bufX = 1-6 vs MQ n01-n06; MM x1,x2,bufX = 1-3 vs MQ n01-n03; FASP DD Lys/Trp = 1/2). Heavy rows: source 'super-SILAC spike-in standard', biological replicate/individual/pooled = pooled, material type cell line, factor value not applicable; spike-in annotated in its own row per SAMPLE-GUIDELINES 'Spiked-in Samples'. Light-row biological replicate 1 per factor group; pooled sample = not available (pooling status of method-optimisation material unstated).

findings.location: comment[cleavage agent details] rows for trypsin-eluate files (*_ddig_Trp / DD_T_*)
findings.message: Trypsin-eluate runs of the consecutive FASP double digestion are annotated with Trypsin only, although the material was pre-digested with Lys-C before the trypsin step.
findings.evidence: Trypsin eluates show 60-71% R-terminal peptides and <1-8% internal K (Lys sites already cut), consistent with Lys-C then trypsin; trypsin specificity [KR] still covers all termini, so reanalysis is unaffected. Correction criterion (optional): add Lys-C as a second cleavage agent for trypsin-eluate rows, or document the sequential scheme.

findings.message: NT=mixed mode chromatography;AC=MS:1003586 is outside the PRIDE:0000550 hierarchy expected by the template, so the validator raises a warning.
findings.evidence: parse_sdrf ms-proteomics template: WARNING 'not found in the given ontology list pride' (warning level, exit 0). Live OLS: MS:1003586 'mixed mode chromatography' exists, not obsolete; PRIDE:0000550 descendants contain no mixed-mode or SDB-RPS term. PRIDE text: 'SDB-RPS plugs (also referred to as mixed-mode in the paper)'. The term is accurate; keep unless a PRIDE term is added.

findings.message: Factor value has no mirroring characteristics/comment column.
findings.evidence: README 'Factor Values' rule: the factor value 'typically mirrors a characteristics column value' (SHOULD-level); sdrf-tools score Design 75/100 for this reason. Correction criterion: optionally add a matching characteristics/comment column (e.g. comment[sample preparation protocol]).

findings.message: Recommended column comment[precursor mass tolerance] is absent.
findings.evidence: MaxQuant 1.5.2.8 parameters.txt in the deposited search zip does not record the main-search precursor tolerance; omission is safer than guessing. sdrf-tools score lists it as a missing recommended column.
